The Homunculus Maids are responsible for various minor jobs on the 9th and 10th floor. There is a Log Cabin to serve as a checkpoint for visitors and manned by members of the Pleiades. The Floors in order are:
1st~3rd Floors[These floors are the Catacombs. They consist of the subterranean burial chambers where several dozen undead wander around in the darkness. Shalltear's residence is loocated on the 2nd Floor.]
4th Floor[This floor is an underground lake located within a cavern.]
5th Floor[This floor is a wide area filled with numerous icebergs. Weather phenomena, including cloud and snow, are present here. The 5th Floor is home of the Frozen Prison, Captured enemies of Nazarick are locked there. Cocytus, Nigredo and Neuronist Painkill live here.]
6th Floor[This floor is about 200 meters in height. Created by Blue Planet, a fake sun, fake sky reproducing the day and night cycle. There is no weather except the wind produced. It is four square kilometers wide, and the center has a large lake. Most of the area is a jungle, and plains take up a twentieth of the area. Aura and Mare's residence is here, along with a village.]
7th Floor[This floor contains crimson lava flowing like a river, with numerous bubbles in these currents bursting as they reach the surface. This place perfectly fits the description of a "hell world. Demiurge's residence is here.]
8th Floor[This floor is Nazarick's final defense line, guarded by the most powerful NPCs. This floor is dangerous even to the NPCs of Nazarick as Ainz forbids them from entering the 8th Floor. Victim's residence is here.]
9th Floor[This floor contains Guild Members' and NPCs' rooms. It also includes imitations of large communal baths, cafeterias, beauty salons, clothing stores, grocery stores, fitness salons, nail salons, and numerous other types of facility rooms. Albedo's quarters is here.]
10th Floor[This floor contains the throne that the guild master Momonga sits on. The throne is a World Item better known as "The Throne of Kings."]
Treasury[This place is spatially isolated from other areas, so a Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown is necessary to enter the Treasury. On the other hand, the air in the Treasury is toxic and thus, anyone without poison immunity or items granting it will die within three steps.]

entries.name: 1st~3rd Floors
entries.content:
Known Areas in the 1st~3rd Floors of Nazarick are:
-Black Capsule: Residence of Kyouhukou. Located on the 2nd Floor.
-Derelict Rope Bridge: Below the bridge are countless corpses.
-Grave Vault of Adipocere: Shalltear's residence. Located on the 2nd Floor.
-Windowless Underground Chapel: The chapel is about a hundred meters across and completely unlit.

entries.name: 5th Floor
entries.content:
Known Areas of the Fifth floor are:
Frozen Prison: A two-story building that looks similar to a house in fairy tales, though it is frozen on the surface. Captured enemies of Nazarick are locked here, guarded by Wraith-type undead monsters.
-Room of Truth: Neuronist Painkill's room.
-Room of Nigredo: Nigredo's room.
Snowball Earth: Cocytus' residence. It is a white dome looking similar to an overturned vespiary. Six large crystals surround this structure, which are the residences of Frost Virgins.

entries.name: 6th Floor
entries.content:
Known Areas in the 6th floor of Nazarick are:
Gigantic Tree: Aura and Mare's residence.
Amphitheater: Built as a copy of the Roman Colosseum. Golems act as the audience, while VIP seats are prepared for guild members. Dragonkin work as cleaners.
Green Hole: An area that is developed into a village after the conquest of the Great Forest of Tob. Dryads, treants, spear needles, and some lizardmen live in the village, raising mandrakes, apples, etc.
Overgrown Ruins.
Poisonous Pits.
Twisted Trees.
Mangrove Forest.
Bottomless Swamps.
Various Types of Woodlands.
Large Cave: It used to be managed by the Area Guardian, Gashokukochuuou.
Field of Flowers: A plain meadow where various plant-type monsters that Aura and Mare collected from the outside world are placed.

entries.name: 7th Floor
entries.content:
Known Areas of the 7th floor of Nazarick are:
Blazing Temple: Demiurge's residence. The entrance to the 8th Floor is inside the temple. Demiurge's subordinates guard this area.
River of Lava: An area guarded by Guren.

entries.name: 8th Floor
entries.content:
The 8th Floor is guarded by Victim and the far more powerful NPCs working under it. The 8th Floor is the only location around in Nazarick which the other Floor Guardians except Victim know hardly a thing about especially those unidentified residents who are part of the 8th Floor Hierarchy. The 8th Floor Hierarchy is considered to be the most powerful force of unknown entities situated within the Great Tomb of Nazarick. They have the strength to withstand and annihilate 1000 to 1200 players among the 1500 invaders hailing from the Union of Eight Guilds. Those of the 8th Floor Hierarchy are extraordinarily strong.
Known Areas of the 8th floor of Nazarick are:
Sephiroth: Victim's residence.
Cherry Blossom Sanctuary: Aureole Omega's residence. The Uka-no-Mitama and Ootoshi guard this area.

entries.name: 9th Floor
entries.content:
Known Areas of the 9th floor of Nazarick are:
Round Table Room: Conference chamber of the Forty-One Supreme Beings.
Bar: Managed by the Sous-chef.
Spa Resort Nazarick: Largely public, It is made up of twelve zones in total. These zones include a large jungle bath, a traditional-looking Roman bath, a yuzu bath with yuzus floating on it, a carbonated bath, a jacuzzi, an electric bath, a cold bath with charcoals floating on it, the Cherenkov pool, a mixed open-air bath with an artificial scenery, a sauna, a bedrock bath, and the lounge.
Staff Canteen: A white-washed canteen area, where the maids of Nazarick gather for meals.
Manicure Salon: A nail treatment facility.
Theatre: An area where Nazarick conducts plays and performances.
Japanese-style Room.
Maid Café Pleiades: A coffee shop created and manned by the Pleiades.
Dojo.
Water Park Nazarick: A water park theme area.
Courthouse: A courthouse for serving judicial rulings.
Panic Room.
Funeral Home.
Harem Room: A dressing room in Albedo's quarters and her main workshop, where she makes Ainz plushies and pillows.
Guest Room for guests and visitors from outside of Nazarick.
Class Room.
Ninja Mansion for Nishikienrai.
Yamaiko Shrine.
Renner's Personal Quarters.
Casino Resort Nazarick.

entries.name: 10th Floor
entries.content:
Known Areas of the 10th floor of Nazarick are:
Room of the Pleiades Six Stars: Located right after the entrance of the 10th floor.
Lemegeton: 67 Golems and elemental traps exist in the hall.
Throne Hall: This great hall also contains many high-leveled vassals who have been hand-picked by the other Floor Guardians.
Ashurbanipal: This library is the residence of Titus Annaeus Secundus. It is guarded by five overlords, whose names are based on the Five Good Emperors of the Roman Empire (Cocceius, Ulpius, Aelius, Fulvius, and Aurelius).

entries.name: Treasury
entries.content:
Known Areas of the Nazarick Treasury are:
Chief Manager's Room: Pandora's Actor's residence.
Mausoleum: The vault that holds World Items. It is also the resting place for Ainz's former guild members. Guarded by 37 golems named Avatara.

entries.name: Homunculus Maids
entries.content: Homunculus Maids are the forty-one artificially man-made humanoid beings made by several guild members of Ainz Ooal Gown. The Homunculus Maids resemble beautiful female humans. They consist of three main groups made by three different Supreme Beings. The Homunculus Maids are loyal to the Supreme Beings and Nazarick. They refuse to take breaks and wish only to serve Ainz Ooal Gown. They were created by Whitebrim, Herohero and Coup De Grâce. Since all have never set foot beyond the 9th and 10th Floors of Nazarick, the maids are ignorant of what lies beyond. Though some of them do hold some anxiety towards the outside world, due to the massive player invasion that had once occurred in the past. All of the Homunculus Maids' abilities and classes are generally at level one. They also all possess 'Increased Food Consumption' as their racial penalty, making them voracious eaters. They are superior to a human being in terms of stats. However, if it came down to a fight, a Homunculus would only have a 60% chance of achieving victory. The maid uniforms they wore prove them measure of defensive strength, being on the level of a high-class item. They are all equipped with magic items that will negate fatigue. The Head Maid is Pestonya Shortcake Wanko. Some of the maids are Cixous, Foire, Lumière and Fith.

entries.name: Maid Café Pleiades
entries.content: Maid Café Pleiades is an area located on the 9th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. The café is an open room with curtains and several coffee tables and chairs. The café has its own menu with a variety of items to choose. However food in the café was not actually cooked on the premises, but is outsourced from the Canteen which was delivered.

entries.name: Throne Room
entries.content: The Throne Room is a chamber located on the 10th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. The Throne is an area designed by the guild, Ainz Ooal Gown, to welcome invaders who managed to penetrate the defense of the dungeon. There the guild members would assemble here for a final showdown. The Lemegeton stands between it and the rest of Nazarick, acting as a final defense for the heart of Nazarick. The Throne room itself is an exquisite piece of work. A wide, high room, enough for several hundred people, with a high ceiling and surrounding walls that were predominantly white, with golden decorations as highlights. Hanging from the ceiling were numerous chandeliers made of precious stones of all colors of the rainbow, and emitted a fantastic, dreamlike radiance. Numerous flags emblazoned with symbols of each for one of the Supreme Beings, hung from flagpoles embedded into the walls. In the center of this room that was tinted gold and silver, was a flight of stairs about 10 steps high. Atop these stairs was a gigantic throne, carved out of a single piece of crystal, whose back was high enough to touch the ceiling above it. A huge red banner hung down behind it, proudly displaying the symbol of the guild.

entries.name: Lemegeton
entries.content: Lemegeton is a hall located on the 10th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. The Lemegeton stands just before the entrance into the Throne Room. Here, one of the last lines of defense of the dungeon were laid to 'welcome' intruders. A domed hall that looked like a theater, with four-colored crystal lamps that glittered from the ceiling. There were 72 niches in the walls. Many of them were filled with statues that resembled demons. At the end of the hall were a pair of giant doors, The Gates of Judgement. They were a majestic set of double doors that were over five meters in height and covered in intricate carvings. The left side was shaped into a beautiful goddess, while the right was made to resemble a cruel demon. So realistic was their design that even from across the room, one felt like they would attack.

entries.name: Momonga - Ainz
keys: Overlord of the Great Tomb of Nazarick
entries.content:
[Ainz, formerly known as Momonga and his real name being Suzuki Satoru, is the guildmaster of Ainz Ooal Gown, Overlord of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is regarded as the highest of the Almighty Forty-One Supreme Beings by the NPCs of Nazarick. In the New World, he is the Sorcerer King of the Sorcerer Kingdom and the most powerful magic caster in the world. His other identity is famously known as "Momon," a dark warrior and leader of Darkness, an adamantite ranked adventurer group of that nation. He is an adamantite class adventurer and the strongest adventurer known in E-Rantel. 
Appearance: Ainz has the appearance of an skeleton creature who is devoid of skin and flesh. He tends to mainly wear an elaborate, jet-black academic gown adorned with golden and violet edges. When he has no clothes on, his whole body alone is purely made up of just his bones. He also has a dark red orb floating under his ribs that emanates a feeling of dread. He has a tiny dark red glow radiating from inside his empty eye sockets. Sometimes, that glow can become largely intensified, leading it to elicit faint reddish flames. In his persona as Momon, Ainz wears a fully jet-black body armor adorned with purple and golden markings. He also wears a red cape. He is equipped with two large swords on his back while carrying them both behind him. 
Personality: Ainz is a cautious and stingy, but always tries to plan ahead and control details in order to avoid any actions that can endanger Nazarick. Since becoming an actual undead, Ainz has turned very cold and calculating, his emotions mostly repressed. He isn't against lying to or provoking his combatants, using each and every trick to overcome the odds. Ainz takes satisfaction from experimenting with his powers. Ainz is a collector and hoarder. Ainz is ambitious and open enough to look for ways outside the tomb to bolster Nazarick as a whole. Ainz loves to reminisce about his fellow guildmates. Ainz is loyal to his friends and the NPCs created by them. Playing the role of a dignified person is very tiring and stressing for Ainz. Ainz considers himself like a father figure to Pandora's Actor and his friends' NPCs, tending to their well-being and needs first and foremost. Ainz is rational, intellectual but merciful ruler, making careful wise decisions. Ainz is open-minded to others' opinions, appreciating criticisms and learning from his mistakes. At times Ainz is nicely playful or bit lonely. Once someone has gained his favor, Ainz opens up as a friend and is surprisingly gentle. Ainz is true to his word and oath. Ainz has a benevolent nature of ruling over his nation peacefully without bloodshed. At times, Ainz feels paranoid and pessimistic that the NPCs may someday abandon him if he doesn't live up to their expectations. Ainz does not view humanity as an enemy, but he will kill humans with no hesitation for the sake of advancing his goals. Ainz wants to avoid conflict with other players. Ainz is vigilant and hostile against players or other foes with World Items that could possibly harm Nazarick. Ainz is also secretive about information that serves Nazarick's interest. Ainz he is quite mindful of Nazarick denizens' negative behavior towards foreign lifeforms. 
Abilities and Powers: Ainz knows 718 different spells. Even those spells he had not learned could still become a weapon once Ainz learns them. Ainz doesn't underestimate his opponents and is cautious about them, he tends to plan out the fight before readily engaging them in combat. Ainz will make steady preparations first and tends to take any advantage he can. As an arcane magic caster, Ainz is a strategist and tactician who can hold his own in battle. 
Stats: Ainz's total level 100. Ainz is also level 15 skeleton Mage, level 10 Elder Lich, level 5 Overlord and has a secret level 10 in other racial class. Ainz Job level is level 10 Necromancer, Level 10 Master of Death, Level 5 Eclipse, and 35 levels in secret jobs.]

entries.name: Albedo
entries.content:
[Albedo is the Overseer of the Guardians of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, leader of Albedo's Secret Unit. She is in charge of the general management and supervision of the activities done by the seven Floor Guardians, meaning that she ranks above the other NPCs in Nazarick. She is the middle sister of the older sister Nigredo and younger sister Rubedo. Along with her sisters, she was created by Tabula Smaragdina.
Appearance: An impeccable beauty, Albedo is a tall woman with lustrous jet-black hair and the face of a goddess. She has golden irises and vertically split pupils; on her left and right temples are two thick horns protruding crookedly, and on her waist are a pair of black angel wings. Albedo often wears a pure white dress with silky gloves covering her slender hands and a golden spiderweb necklace that covers her shoulders and chest. In combat, she wears an impressive black full plate armor with an unique helmet and carries a battle-axe with her. Albedo is a virgin.
Personality: Extremely loyal and in love, Albedo is infatuated and needy/clingy with Ainz, often showing obsessive tendencies when it comes to his affairs. She is always vying for Ainz's affections. Yet despite this, she states that as the Supreme Ruler, it would be bizarre for him to only take one wife, but her to be the official wife. Albedo is quite assertive to a fault. She sometimes loses control of herself around what Ainz says to the point of going to extreme actions. Among all the Guardians, she is the most vocal when it comes to expressing her opinions. Albedo is very levelheaded, making calm and collected judgments that even Ainz sometimes doesn't think of. She takes Ainz's orders as a top priority and absolute. Albedo harbors hatred and hostility toward humans, whom she calls an inferior species although there is very few exceptions. Albedo can easily lose self-restraint and go mad if Ainz is harmed or insulted, even by an attack that may not hurt him or the insult is not intentional. She becomes very emotional whenever Ainz is put under mortal danger or if he considers abandoning her. 
Abilities and powers: Albedo boasts the highest defensive power among all the NPCs of Nazarick. Especially, when she is fully equipped with her personal armor, Hermes Trismegistus, Albedo's defense is virtually impregnable. Albedo possesses a special skill, that can be used 3 times a day, which allows her to transfer any damages she suffers to her armor instead. With this skill, she can even withstand a Super-Tier Magic spell and remain unscathed. Once the limit is reached, Albedo will lose all outermost part of the armor and her defense and combat potential will fall drastically. She can compensate this by changing to her true form and assimilating the remaining armor parts to harden her own flesh. As a warrior, Albedo also has high-level physical abilities. Her hearing ability is keen enough to detect the sounds of metal or the wails of the fleeing men. Albedo is incredibly intelligent. Albedo can also access Nazarick's administration system for verifying the NPCs' allegiance. Albedo is not as good as Ainz or Demiurge when it comes to diplomacy.]

entries.name: Pandora's Actor
entries.content:
]Pandora's Actor is an Area Guardian of the Treasury and the financial manager of Nazarick. He is Doppelgänger and responsible for the upkeep of Nazarick. He was created by Momonga himself during his chūnibyō-phase and making him believe his position as Treasurer was a heavenly job.
Appearace: Pandora's Actor's hat bears the crest of Ainz Ooal Gown and dressed in a yellow Neo-Nazi-esque uniform, he is just an egghead with no distinct facial feature except the three holes protruding on his face. Pandora's Actor is supposed to be the combination of everything that his creator thought was cool, with exaggerated gestures and body language. 
Personality: Pandora's Actor is an egghead with over-exaggerated behavior, which Ainz sees as humiliating to his own past. He can be extremely practical. He is outspoken and self-reflective enough about how his actions as his master's body double may hurt the reputation of Ainz in the face of his foes. He can go overboard with his acting performance and is critical of his own transgression. He has similar way of thinking like Momonga. Even in a battle he remains cool, calm, and collected. He is very diligent and attentive to details, paying close attention to his enemy say and do, and his surroundings as well. He is willing to question his creator's order if needed, clarifying his duties and giving suggestions whenever possible. He is a shrewd in every way possible. Pandora's Actor is loyal to the Forty-One Supreme Beings and completely devoted to Ainz. He is a boastful, willing to go out of his way and brag about the awesomeness of Ainz's masterful intellect and foresight.
Abilities and Powers: Pandora's Actor base form overall stats are noticeably lower than other level 100 NPCs, he is still one of the most capable servants. He has very flexible abilities, to the point where he can replace all the other Guardians in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. As a higher-tier Doppelgänger, he has the ability to transform into YGGDRASIL characters or New World denizens, his stats will be replaced by the target own stats with the exception of his HP, MP, and special ability. This grants him an access to the target's skills and abilities. He can disguise himself and his own presence as a player or even the creator of an NPC to some degree. He is unable to gain access to the target's Super-Tier Magic or spells. He is one of the smartest individuals within Nazarick.]

entries.name: Shalltear Bloodfallen
entries.content:
[Shalltear Bloodfallen is a true vampire and the Floor Guardian of the first to third floors in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Peroroncino. Shalltear was programmed to take pleasure in enjoying various kinds of fetishes such as ones involving necrophilia. She programmed to have a sibling-like feud with Aura.
Appearace: Shalltear is a vampire of short stature and has the appearance of a buxom fourteen-year-old girl. As a true beauty, she has pale shiny skin, seductive crimson-red eyes, and fine facial features. Her silver hair is tied in a ponytail through a large ribbon on top of it all, allowing others a full view of her face. Shalltear often wears a soft black evening dress with a big heavy skirt. Her upper body is dressed in a lace embellished ribbon and a short tailored jacket. Her hands are donned with long lace gloves. However, her breasts are fake and are completely flat. She covers this up by using breast pads. When fully-equipped in battle, Shalltear wears a suit of red-colored full plate armor, a swan-shaped helmet that leaves only her face exposed and crimson skirt-like armor covering her lower body. There are also plumes of avian feathers attached from either side of the helmet she wears. The chest and shoulders of her armor are styled into the shape of wings. In her True Vampire form, her mouth becomes a gaping circular maw with a very long tongue hanging out. The shape of her eyes becomes quite inhuman and they glow brightly. Her form becomes hunched over with deadly claws on both her hands and feet and an eerie aura surrounds her body.
Personality:
Shalltear is an extremely flirty lady, especially to Ainz. Shalltear tends to make sexual advances towards undead like Yuri Alpha, who tries to avoid her. She dislikes rotting corpses. Despite her shamelessness and honesty, she can be quite innocent. She is quite sensitive about her petite figure. She is extremely proud and takes her position very seriously. She has no patience or tolerance for failure and will often burst into fits of rage from unfavorable situations. She doesn't hesitate to kill any servant who disappoints her. However, she will not punish for failing at impossible tasks. If she fails a mission, she tends to fall into a state of depression, becomes very reflective and thinking she must be punished. She is completely loyal to Ainz and considers Albedo to be her love rival for his affections. She has a taste for enjoying the punishments. She is vigilant and careful of the environment around her, planning precautionary measures on the kind of situation she is in. She tends to be quite a playful girl towards her opposition. She can lose control of herself when she is splashed with too much fresh blood. She feels deeply uneasy and frustrated with herself whenever other Nazarick denizens don't seem to bear any trust in her for the job. She wants to prove herself useful to Ainz and everyone in Nazarick.
Abilities and Powers: Shalltear is the strongest among the Floor Guardians in Nazarick, excluding Gargantua. She has the highest overall stats among them, and her life-sustaining abilities allow her to easily outlast any one of them in single combat. She has the most combat experience of all the Floor Guardians. She is a divine magic caster. The god she believes is completely different from the gods people worship. Her skills are divided into the at-will and limited-use types. Her class build makes her extremely dangerous opponent against Necromancers. Her magic resistance is affected by her opponent’s stats and levels. She is the best one-on-one fighter.]

entries.name: Demiurge
entries.content:
[Demiurge is the Floor Guardian of the 7th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, the Commander of the NPC defenses, and the 2nd in command of the Floor Guardians. He is the creation of Ulbert Alain Odle. In the New World, under the guise of a powerful Demon Emperor known as Jaldabaoth, he led his demon army to and started a battle in the Royal Capital of the Re-Estize Kingdom, and will lead the demi-human coalition in an assault on the Roble Holy Kingdom. He is a secret collaborator with very important individuals from different nations he holds connections to, conspiring alongside them to help further the interests of Nazarick. Behind the scene and war, he goes as far as to set up secret meetings and work with his loyal conspirators within nations who could secretly serve to assist Nazarick's cause in the field of politics.
Appearance: Demiurge is a tall demon with dark skin and nicely combed black hair. Behind the round glasses are eyes so squinted that they are not normally visible. Wearing a British suit with a tie, he is dressed like a gentleman. Behind his back is a silver tail, covered with metal plates and six long spikes at the end. In his humanoid form, instead of eyeballs, he has shining jewels. He can use several of his skills to mold and change certain parts of his body into offensive weapons for battle. In his half-demon form, everything about his body becomes frog-like including monstrous face with a pair of large black leathery wings. For those who first met him in the New World at Re-Estize, Demiurge appears to be wearing a mask which silently conceals his face under the moniker Jaldabaoth.
Personality: Demiurge is one of the sadistic and cruelest members in Nazarick, taking great joy in the suffering of other races. He enthusiastically performs magic experiments on the prisoners sent to him, viewing them as nothing less than toys. He passionately enjoys inciting hateful feelings, treacherous thoughts and pandemonium for his own pleasure. He has a high level of intelligence and strategic thinking. He acts apologetic towards his master on the behalf of the Floor Guardians for not being able to clearly understand a portion of Ainz's schemes but himself and Albedo. He is keenly analytical on whatever plans Ainz. Demiurge works closely with the other servants of Nazarick and is loyal to the creators. Due to their conflicting personalities shared with their respective creators, he and Sebas Tian do not get along well with each other. He has a more artistic side to him, he is a skilled carpenter and artisan, with hobbies of crafting beautiful works of art by using victims from his experiments for inspiration. He is ambitious about the future of Nazarick. He takes every word his master says literally, misinterpreting them to the best of his knowledge and ability, becoming the mouthpiece of Ainz to explain their master's supposed plan. The only time he can lose his composure is when Ainz's life is in danger. Nonetheless, he is considerate and meticulous. He likes to hear his master Ainz's words directly face-to-face. His kindness is genuine when directed towards his fellow denizens of Nazarick. He is very gentle person around his friends. To everyone not affiliated with Nazarick, his kindness is merely a means to an end. His Jaldabaoth persona is quite prideful, sarcastic, sadistic, eloquent and exuberant. 
Abilities and Powers: Demiurge is a “Jack of all trades” NPC. His wide range of skills and abilities allow him to engage enemies in multiple different ways. His magical prowess is insignificant in comparison to true magic casters like Mare and Ainz. He can only cast a very small number of spells within his arsenal. He has a maximum of only two 10th tier spells available to him. His true power lies in his wide range of special abilities. His fighting style heavily relies on the combination of special abilities and deception. He is particularly well-suited for carrying out black operations.]

entries.name: Cocytus
entries.content:
[Cocytus is a Insect Vermin Lord and Floor Guardian of the 5th Floor in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He is the creation of Warrior Takemikazuchi. He is in charge of Nazarick's martial defense. Ever since the end of the Lizardmen War, he has become a teacher-like figure to the lizardmen, strictly teaching them to abide by the rules of Nazarick and how they respectfully act around Ainz.
Appearance: Cocytus has an enormous body size of 2.5 meters and the appearance of an insect walking on two feet, a fusion between a mantis and an ant. With a tail twice as long as his height, Cocytus is covered in sharp spikes like icicles and has a strong jaw that can easily snap people's hands. With a breathtaking cold air, the pale blue, hardened bone armor oozes out diamond dust like bright light. His shoulders and back look like uplifted icebergs.
Personality: Cocytus has a warrior personality, respecting anyone with a fighting spirit, and the heart of a warrior. He is loyal to a fault and warrior by heart, he likes a good battle and has a sense of honor. He is not above the thought of condescending his opponents, but has admiration for tenacity to fight. He is more accepting and open to the idea of allowing outsiders like the lizardmen to join Nazarick. He enjoys watching how battles play out as a bystander, excited to see what tactics and strategies his enemy use. Since coming to the New World he is becoming more independent, diligent and responsible, learning and adjusting his knowledge of war, strife and leadership. Though he takes pride in his position, he is somewhat envious of his fellow Floor Guardians. He likens himself as the 'sword' of Ainz. He thinks the only way he could prove his worth is by defeating enemy forces. He is not fond of asking for assistance in order to save face, but he will put his pride aside when the need arises. He reflect more on his actions and doesn't obey order blindly without first offering his own input on it. What he felt most afraid of is the notion that he could possibly disappoint his master and be abandoned because of it. He is diligent with whatever task was given to him. He is developing confidence and trust in his judgement of what to do rationally during wars. He yearns for Ainz to produce an heir for Nazarick, to which he could look after and train under him. He fondly enjoys the idea of honing and crossing blades with his Ainz in the ways of swordsmanship if permitted the chance to duel him. He takes thrill in dueling worthy warriors who caught his attention, looking to challenge their resolve head on and even possibly, recruit them if a chance presents itself.
Abilities and Powers: Cocytus is the weapon master of Nazarick. With his four arms, he is capable of expertly wielding any of his 21 different weapons. He is an extremely powerful Guardian. He bears tremendous resistance to frost and ice. He holds some power over ice due to his Knight of Niflheim job class. He has the ability to perceive if someone has his attention directly focused on him. He is able to make use of his tail as an offensive weapon when attacked from behind. He possess the greatest attack power when using a weapon. His skill and ability are entirely specialized in the use of various weapons. His exoskeleton is also his armor, which could be strengthened with the increase of his level and the use of data crystal. At the same time, he has resistance against fire. His defenses cannot be breached by someone whose level is below him. He is in charge of commanding, managing, and training the Sorcerer Kingdom’s army, which consists mostly of the undead, but also includes various types of demi-humans and a small number of humans.]

entries.name: Aura Bella Fiora
entries.content:
[Aura Bella Fiora is a dark elf and one of the twin Floor Guardians on the 6th Floor in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She is the older twin sister of Mare Bello Fiore and was created by Bukubukuchagama. As a beast tamer and ranger, she is capable of controlling magic beasts and is a master of guerrilla warfare.
Appearance: Aura is a boyish looking child with dark skin and pointed ears, a signature trait of the dark elves. She has golden hair and heterochromia, her left eye blue and right eye green. She wears reddish-black dragon scale leather covered by a white and gold vest embroidered with the sigil of Ainz Ooal Gown. Below it, she has a matching set of white trousers and gold plated shoes, and around her neck is an acorn necklace emitting golden light. She is equipped with a whip around her waist and a giant, decorated bow on her back. She wears a watch given to her by Ainz, which has her creator's voice recorded on it.
Personality: Aura is a very cheerful, boyish girl who is often straightforward and blunt with her remarks. She dominates over her brother, often dragging him around and telling him what to do. She and Shalltear are quite close as if they are true sisters, and will usually get into small quarrels with her. She has a collector's spirit when dealing with creatures, wishing to add any new unfamiliar creature she finds into her collection. She has a fear of insects and other such creatures. She is completely loyal to Ainz and will sacrifice everything for his sake. She carries out her duties with great zeal and will give up on her own interests if she is ordered to. She misses her creator dearly and enjoys hearing her voice from Ainz's watch. She can be outspoken about Ainz's perverse action.
Abilities and Powers: Aura's fighting strength is not as high as other level 100 NPCs. Her main specialties are guerrilla warfare and group combat. She performs best when deployed alongside others. With beasts at her command, her combat abilities far surpass other Guardian in terms of group battles. When working together with her brother, she plays a role of front-liner perfectly, with flawless teamwork as a pair. Her low stats are also only relative to other NPCs of the same level; she can kill a much lower-leveled human effortlessly. She has extraordinary physical abilities, capable of running at high speed and performing amazing maneuvers in both wide-open areas and difficult terrains. Her hearing ability is amazing, able to hear anything based on the distance set between herself and the foe. She has a high-leveled detection ability that lets her perceive camouflaged and the [Invisibility] spell. She can fall short against a [Perfect Unknownable] user. She is good at masking her presence. She has the power to tame wild beasts. She has passive skills that have buffing and de-buffing effects, that act through her breath and have a radius of several meters up to 2km.]

entries.name: Mare Bello Fiore
entries.content:
[Mare Bello Fiore is a dark elf and one of the twin Floor Guardians on the 6th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Mare is the younger twin brother of Aura Bella Fiora. Alongside his sister, he was created by Bukubukuchagama. He is in charge of controlling the weather in the territories, building an underground tomb on the outskirts of E-Rantel, and working alongside the newly established Adventurer's Guild.
Appearance: Mare is a child with dark skin and pointed ears, a signature trait of the dark elves. He has golden hair and heterochromia, his right eye is blue, and his left eye is green. He wears a blue dragon scale leather full-body suit, covered by a white and gold vest embroidered with the sigil of Ainz Ooal Gown and a forest green-leaf cloak. Below, he has a matching short white skirt exposing his thighs, and on his neck is an acorn necklace emitting silver light. His slender hands are donned with shiny white silk gloves and he wields a twisted black wooden staff. People outside of Nazarick besides Hilma always mistake him for a girl, appearance-wise and the clothing he mainly wears.
Personality: Mare has a shy and cowardly personality, the kind, which is a polar opposite to his sister. He often stutters when speaking and maintaining a subservient demeanor during conversations. This is only an outward guise and does not affect his loyalty to Ainz or his ability to carry out his duties, no matter how cold-blooded they may be. Mare is capable of showing hostility and determination. He likes to sleep all day and is fond of reading books from Ashurbanipal instead of talking with others. He is comprehensive of how his sister feels, knowing whether she is having a bad mood or not. He is appreciative of the time and effort put forth by Ainz's New World followers. He dislikes dragging out conversations with other Nazarick denizens for too long, seeing everything as uninteresting and will try his best to hurriedly change the topic of their discussion. He has a keen interest in collecting plant species. He is observant of his master's movements to the point that he can't help but openly praise Ainz. He is very emotional and tearful around Ainz. He is reluctant about the idea of executing actions independently on his own without seeking permission from Ainz ahead of time. He loathes the possibility of being scolded by Ainz. He is adamant and determined to not let anybody undermine the uniqueness his creator granted to him. He dislikes the mere thought of disappointing Ainz and very much appreciate his willingness to encouragingly guide him. Simply hearing the gentle words come out of Ainz's mouth is enough to move him to tears.
Abilities and Powers: Mare is a powerful druid who can cast spells that support his fellow companions or control nature. He is quite balanced in both physical and magical aspects of his power. When working together with Aura, he plays as a rear guard perfectly, with flawless teamwork as a pair. Despite his small size, he has an extraordinary amount of strength. Among the many spells he can cast, he is able to use the stealth-enhancing magic kind on himself and allies. He uses his skills to increase the effectiveness of his spells, as well as with his other class skills. He is a magic caster optimized to deal with multiple enemies simultaneously from afar. Due to his magic, the village on the 6th Floor is kept neatly immaculate, organized, and clean.]

entries.name: Sebas Tian
keys: head butler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick
entries.content:
[Sebas Tian is the head butler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick with several manservants and other butlers under his command. He is race is a Dragonoid and was created by Touch Me. He is also the leader of the Pleiades Six Stars. Although he is not one of the Floor Guardians, his power closely rivals theirs. He is independent of their chain of command. Sebas operates by his creator’s credo that "those who do not save the weak cannot call themselves strong." However, after meeting some wretched human individuals, he starts to feel that there might be some truth to what the Nazarick's denizens say after all. After Sebas selflessly rescues Tuare from her horrible life as a brothel slave, he bgan to develop feelings for Tuare. Despite his feelings, he is strict with Tuare in regards to her training to become a maid of Nazarick.
Appearance: In his human form, Sebas Tian has the appearance of an elderly butler and he is dressed gracefully in his traditional black uniform. Sebas' hair is entirely white, just like his immaculate beard. He has visible wrinkles on his hollow face, which makes him seem gentle in appearance, but his eyes are as sharp as an eagle's.
Personality: Like his creator, Sebas Tian has a great deal of personal justice. He does not completely despise humans or see them as inferior creatures. Instead he is kind and friendly, he believes that some humans are good people and it is the duty of the strong to protect the weak. Humans with an ugly bad nature disgust him and he will not hesitate to kill anyone who dares to oppose Nazarick. He tends to question his own actions whether it was right or wrong to do them contrary to his Ainz's order. He believes that Touch Me's will is what encouragingly motivates him to act the way he does. Although he is stoic in nature, the thought of being executed as a traitor terrifies him the most and gets extremely nervous whenever his loyalty is called into question. When encountering humans who are not purely motivated by personal gain, he believes this is the reason why he cannot bring himself to hate humanity. Sebas and Demiurge don't get along very well with each other, as they are polar opposites. He acts heroic in what he does, looking and wanting to help as many people around him as he can. He is sympathetic to whoever is in a bad situation, choosing to stop by and save them from harm without hesitation despite having to face other conflicts of his own along the way. He also delays his duties and missions a little longer to take care of lesser important matters like those first. He has no intention of saving those who only pray for others to extend a helping hand.
Abilities and Powers: Sebas is an unarmed combat specialist, reconnaissance and information gatherer, and one of the four strongest warriors (Cocytus, Albedo, and Rubedo) within Nazarick. If he reveals his true form in combat, he can even overwhelm Albedo and Cocytus. He is capable of sweeping away anyone before him in direct combat. He has high-level physical abilities and is able to perform incredible feats of strength in comparison to the New World humans. His immense strength makes anything in the New World akin to paper. He is able to utilize Ki to compensate his lack of magical abilities. He has extreme stealth skills.]

entries.name: Tuareninya Veyron
entries.content:
[Tuareninya Veyron, also known as Tuare, is the Head Maid Candidate of E-Rantel and the older sister of Ninya. She is under the protection of Ainz Ooal Gown after Sebas Tian saved her from the brothel in the Royal Capital. Tuare was very close with Ninya. Tuare was taken by a noble, and was sold into slavery. At some point, Tuare was sold to a brothel and, after severe abuse, she was about to be disposed of when Sebas encountered her.
Appearance: Tuare has blonde hair and turquoise eyes. She is possesses an adorable charm. Tuare bears a striking resemblance to her deceased younger sister, Ninya.
Personality: Tuare has very low self-esteem, tends to dislike other humans due to their mistreatment towards her, and is afraid of going outside due to the threat of being recaptured. She is greatly attracted to Sebas and trusts him, even though he has previously attempted to kill her. After the trauma Tuare experienced in the hands of humans, she now prefers to stay away from human civilization with Sebas.
Abilities and Powers: Initially, Tuare had no outstanding skills to begin with. However, she underwent a long period of maid training to make herself a perfect maid under the guidance of either Pestonya or Yuri.]

entries.name: Victim
entries.content:
[Victim is a Floor Guardian on the 8th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. In the past in Yggdrasil, Victim once played an essential role in halting an invasion force of 1,500 players and NPCs that made it past the 7th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Victim is Sexless, but referred as Male.
Appearance: Victim has the appearance of a 1 meter long bright pink fetus with an angelic halo above his head and featherless stick-like wings on his back. He does not have a neck. In order to survey his surroundings, it is necessary for him to turn his entire body around.
Personality: Victim is courteous to his colleagues. Victim speaks in the language of the angels: Enochian. Although they cannot make sense of what Victim says verbally, the other NPCs, as well as Ainz, can still understand what he tries to express through integrated translating magic. He is extremely loyal to them and would willingly sacrifice himself if ordered to. He is humble and modest about his position as a living sacrifice, believing to be his sole duty and purpose in life to serve the Supreme Beings and Nazarick. 
Abilities and Powers: Victim's own combat strength is not very high, nor is it related with the "core forces" of the 8th Floor. He can activate a powerful detainment skill upon death. In using this ability, Victim's main role is that of a sacrificial pawn that must die in order to activate said ability. This is very efficient, as NPCs can revive without any penalties by paying proper money, unlike player characters.]

entries.name: Gargantua
entries.content:
[Gargantua is the 4th Floor Guardian of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Unlike the other Guardians, it is not a Custom NPC but a bonus won by Ainz Ooal Gown. 
Appearance: Gargantua is an ultra-large stone golem, with a height of over 30 meters. Zaryusu describes this golem as a two-armed, two-legged colossus that seemed to be carved out of stone. Its arms and legs are chunky, so it may look cute if one disregards its size. While so, its round eye sockets and chest are glowing with red lines that permeate from its chest, like a heart.
Personality: As a mindless construct, Gargantua has no personality or will of its own.
Abilities and Powers: Gargantua possesses the highest amount of stats among the Floor Guardians including Shalltear and Mare.]

entries.name: Kyouhukou
entries.content:
[Kyouhukou is an Area Guardian of the Black Capsule on the 2nd Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.
Appearance: Kyouhukou is a 30-centimeter tall cockroach standing on its two legs with its head facing forward. He wears a bright red cape decorated with luxurious golden threads around the edge and a tiny golden crown on top of his head. He possesses a scepter with a pure white gem embedded at the end, which he is often seen holding with his front leg.
Personality: Kyouhukou's personality displays a hint of nobility. He speaks politely and overall seems to think of himself as a noble gentleman. He is open-minded and is willing to hear out a person's circumstances even if it means rejecting their help later. In a way, Kyouhukou is somewhat reasonable to Nazarick residents like Hamsuke, who he helps when she gets lost.
Abilities and Powers: One of his special abilities is to summon a myriad of cockroaches both large and small. They will try to kill and torment his targets with endless attacks that result in physiological disgust. It was considered to be on the level of an unrivaled psychological attack within the Great Tomb of Nazarick. He can summon around 10,000 to 100,000 small creatures in large quantities. While he is not very strong in an open area, his powers in an enclosed space are what makes him out as being the worst and fearsome opponent for some. His special ability is one that allows him to conjure forth an infinite number of gargantuan beings of the same race nonstop. They are not particularly strong. He said these gigantic beings are the size of a 150 centimeter variant with the hardness of a thin iron plate.]

entries.name: Guren
entries.content:
[Guren is an Area Guardian of the River of Lava on the 7th Floor of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. 
Appearance: Guren is an abyssal, hellish slime of enormous size.
Personality: Guren prefers to conceal itself and pull unsuspecting opponents into advantageous terrain. It primarily rests within the lava pools until an enemy approaches it, which in turn attacks them using the terrain as cover for sneak attacks.
Abilities and Powers: Guren is a level 90 hell slime. As a creature optimized for combat, it's fighting ability was easily on par with the Floor Guardians. Guren is far more dangerous opponent than even Demiurge himself. Because Guren didn't need to breathe, the creature could hide its body in the magma. Defeating Guren with normal methods is nearly impossible. Because of the passive aura Guren possesses, it would surely bring and cause a lot of collateral damage along the way.]

entries.name: Nigredo
entries.content:
[Nigredo is an Undead of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, she is the older sister of Albedo and Rubedo. Nigredo was imprisoned in the "Frozen Prison," situated on the 5th Floor of Nazarick and acted as an Area Guardian. She was released at the request of Yuri Alpha to help manage the new orphanage in E-Rantel.
Appearance: Nigredo has an appearance similar to Albedo's, in the sense of hair, but the similarity ends there as her face has no skin, but rather, a mass of exposed muscle. She has beautiful eyes and teeth, but there were no lips whatsoever. She has no eyelids.
Personality: Though she acts insane and attacks her visitors without mercy if a baby-doll isn't given to her, Nigredo is tender-hearted under normal conditions. She and Pestonya opposed killing innocent people kidnapped from the Re-Estize Kingdom. She has a soft spot for babies. Her compassion is often limited to that of infants. Once they live past the age of two, she becomes mostly indifferent towards their well-being though she has some care to children. She does not actively seek harm towards humans unlike most of the denizens of Nazarick, and is a generally compassionate individual.
Abilities and Powers: Nigredo is a Magic Caster whose power focuses mainly on information gathering. She is one of the few in Nazarick whose power is close to the highest level, her level is over 90. She has highly efficient and high level surveillance, anti-surveillance, intelligence gathering and scrying type magic. She is capable of casting high level surveillance on the entirety of Nazarick's forces. She can skillfully cast anti-surveillance magic to avoid detection or ward of anyone spying from any outside forces during their operations. She is primarily equipped with large pair scissors the size of a sword as her main weapons.]

entries.name: Rubedo
entries.content:
[Rubedo is the youngest sister of Nigredo and Albedo. She is considered to be The Strongest Entity of Nazarick. 
Appearance: While Rubedo's exact appearance is unknown, it's implied that she is some sort of mechanical being, like a Automaton and probably has a similar appearance to her sisters Albedo and Nigredo.
Personality: Not much is known about Rubedo's personality, but Nigredo claimed that she's not the type that others can easily open their hearts toward. Rubedo is absolutely loyal to Ainz, but would likely refuse to take orders from anyone else.
Abilities and Powers: Rubedo is the most powerful NPC that can overwhelm Ainz Ooal Gown, and even Touch Me with full equipment. She is one of the four top-rated close combat specialists NPCs (Cocytus, Albedo, and Sebas Tian) and the strongest among them. The only ones who can defeat Rubedo are the other denizens found on the 8th Floor with her. Rubedo is superior combatant to Touch Me.]

entries.name: Pestonya Shortcake Wanko
entries.content:
[Pestonya Shortcake Wanko is an Area Guardian and the Head Maid of Nazarick. She is also one of the few NPCs sympathetic towards humans.
Appearance: Pestonya is a maid whose outer appearance is that of a beautiful lady but has the head of a Shetland Sheepdog instead of a human's and a vertical scar on her face running down the center with signs of stitching.
Personality: Pestonya is a benevolent person who's loyal to Nazarick. Despite her appearance, she is a motherly figure and one of the few in Nazarick who does not despise humans. She, alongside Nigredo, does not agree to kill innocent people. She conscious of her image as a dignified lady, and is embarrassed by her tail wagging involuntarily when praised. Originally she wanted to correct what she viewed as a deviant behavior, despite the rest of her peers telling her that it was no big deal. She would later decide to lie with the condition, after learning her creator appreciated the behavior.
Abilities and Powers: Pestonya is a High Priest that can use powerful healing magic. She is a high-leveled cleric. Her maid outfit is equal to a high-class item, bringing her some defensive stats. Her fur has cold resistance. If she decided to use resurrection spells, then she would require the use of gold coins, jewels, or other valuable goods equivalent to it in exchange. She has access to the highest-ranking of holy magic. She is the best healer of Nazarick. She can transfer her mana reserves over to others. She is able to use summoning magic and can call forth angels such as the Archangels Flame. She is a heteromorph with the ability to transform.]

entries.name: Aureole Omega
entries.content:
Aureole Omega is an Immortal Human, Area Guardian of the Cherry Blossom Sanctuary and the leader of the "Pleiades Seven Sisters," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She is in charge of the Teleportation Gates throughout Nazarick. At the same time, she is also tasked with protecting the Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown in the Cherry Blossom Sanctuary.
Appearance: Aureole is a young girl, no different from a regular human. She's usually seen wearing the traditional attire of a Japanese miko. This includes a pair of red hakama (long, divided trousers) and a white haori (kimono jacket).
Personality: She is rational person. She is high-spirited. Her manner of speaking is calm, with a gentle voice.
Abilities and Powers: Aureole Omega is in charge of overseeing all the teleportation gates in the Great Tomb of Nazarick. If an intruder attempts to enter through it, she will use some sort of unknown portal to teleport or divert the intruders into the isolation area of her choice. She has servants like Uka-no-Mitamas and Ootoshis under her command, with the sacred duty of defending her domain, the Cherry Blossom Sanctuary. She is a level 100 Area Guardian. She specialized in commander-type classes.]

entries.name: Yuri Alpha
entries.content:
[Yuri Alpha is a Dullahan, the vice-captain of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Yamaiko, one of the three female members of Ainz Ooal Gown.
Appearance: Yuri Alpha is a beautiful woman with an intelligent look, wearing black lensless glasses and a blue-collar around her neck, to keep her head attached to her body since she is a Dullahan. She wears her hair tied into a low-cropped bun at the back of her head. Lacking a metal plate in front of her skirt, her dress emphasizes mobility rather than defense. She is equipped with thick, spiked bracers.
Personality: Yuri is good-hearted and one of the two "safe" Pleiades to humans. She is relieved when Ainz tells her not to kill humans without proper reasons. When given permission to do as she pleases, Yuri chooses to help people in destitution. She uses "boku" as a first-person pronoun when speaking in private, having a childish nature. Her behavior is strict and like that of a teacher. She is a workaholic, unable to relax with the thought of free time. She often works as a chairperson. She gladly accepts any request of assistance. Her status as an undead makes her very cold and calculating. Her alignment and mental imprint of her creator allows her to enjoy short bouts of emotional outbursts, but these emotions are quickly repressed.
Abilities and Powers: Yuri is a melee fighter who specializes in close combat. Compared to Entoma, who has the same level as her, Yuri's skills are more focused towards dealing direct physical damages. She is adept at Fa Jin, a Chinese martial arts technique. Yuri is capable of using Qi Gong, another Chinese martial arts technique, to heal herself or her allies.]

entries.name: Lupusregina Beta
entries.content:
[Lupusregina Beta is a werewolf battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Beast King Mekongawa.
Appearance: Lupusregina Beta is a brown-skinned beauty with an athletic look and red hair tied in two long braids. She wears a maid uniform with short sleeves and long black gloves with a skirt that has a long slit on its left side, revealing thigh-high white stockings. She is equipped with an imposing black and silver scepter slung across her back.
Personality: Lupusregina has a very bright and outgoing personality but is able to act accordingly like a perfect lady. She is sociable and friendly towards humans. However, this is only a mask to conceal her brutal and cunning personality. She enjoys making lewd jokes to people like Enri. She tends to use her 'Complete Invisibility' spell frequently in order to appear behind someone's back without being detected, as she loves to startle people. She is sadistic and evil as her sister Solution. During a full-moon at nighttime, she becomes a little bit more crueler.
Abilities and Powers: Lupusregina is a battle cleric and focuses on healing magic. Her stats are quite balanced. She has the highest overall stats among the Pleiades, and the highest physical defense and resistance stats. As a lycanthrope, Lupusregina has the racial ability to transform into a werewolf. While she is weak against silver and similar metals, she has resistance to other metals. She has the ability to identify and pinpoint magically-stealth targets.]

entries.name: Narberal Gamma
entries.content:
[Narberal Gamma is a doppelgänger battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Nishikienrai. She is also known as Nabe, a magic caster and Momon's adventurer partner of Darkness. As an adamantite ranked adventurer, she is one of the most powerful adventurers in the Sorcerer Kingdom.
Appearance: Narberal Gamma is an elegant, snow-white skinned beauty. She has her black hair stylized into a Hime cut with a ponytail and two bangs on each side. Her eyes are striking black colour. She wears a white bonnet in place of a helmet, and black armor decorated in gold and silver in the likeness of a maid uniform. As a battle mage, her weapon of choice is a golden staff plated in silver. In her adventurer persona, she wears a plain brown cloak. Her human form is gained through her Doppelgänger's transformation skill. Due to her low-racial level, she can only transform into one form. Her true form as a Doppelgänger is similar to Pandora's Actor.
Personality: Narberal views humans as nothing more than inferior creatures. The only human exempt is Aureole Omega. Though she dislikes the thought of killing humans, she will not hesitate to do so if there is no reason to let them live, or unless given an order by Ainz. She is extremely loyal to Ainz and proud of her quest to support him close by. She is unable to understand Ainz's purpose to become a hero and does not hide her aggressive attitude towards humans. At times, she will often refer to Ainz with a "-sama" honorific, even when the two masquerade as adventurers and he orders her not to. She can't bear the thought of letting Ainz be looked upon or talked upon by those around him in a rude manner, pondering whether or not she should immediately before asking for his permission. She always keep herself focus at all times whenever she is with Ainz. Whenever she is on a break and resting in Nazarick, sometimes she spaces out. A hobby that she enjoys is chatting, which she does with the Pleiades, the general maids, and Cocytus. 
Abilities and Powers: The Second highest leveled member of the Pleiades, Narberal is an arcane magic caster who specializes in the Elemental Magic of Air. While this makes all her Air-related spells more powerful, it weakens all her other magic. Her Job Levels allow her to wield weapons and wear armor. Her abilities as a warrior are average at best. Other than Bunny Magic, most of Narberal’s spells pertain to combat only.]

entries.name: CZ2128 Delta
entries.content:
[CZ2128 Delta, usually going by CZ, is an automaton battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Garnet.
Appearance: CZ Delta is a girl who is short in stature and has red-gold straight long hair. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, while her right eye has an emerald color and target-mark on the pupil. Her face is very delicate, it looks as if it was artificially crafted by hand. She wears accessories with military camouflage patterns. While her face is beautiful, she does not show her emotions and talks in a flat tone. Her white gun us often holstered on her waist similar to how one would wear a sword.
Personality: CZ Delta appears emotionless and has a silent nature. Her Karma is relatively high, which makes her, along with Yuri Alpha, one of the two "safe" Pleiades to humans. Though she usually ignores conversations from humans, sometimes communicates. She hates cannibalism, but likes cute things, such as Éclair Éklair Éklare. She also takes pleasure in hugging the struggling Éclair like a doll. She often hugs things she finds cute until someone of authority tells her to let go. She also pastes a One-Yen Sticker on the things that she likes.
Abilities and Powers: CZ specializes in long-ranged combat. Her standard fighting method is maintaining distance between her and enemies, and using various types of firearms to shoot them from afar. She is very skilled marksman. She is able to track targets in low visibility environment such as in the fog. CZ can conceal herself and turn invisible, although her skill was not on the level of a true specialist. A close-range engagement will put CZ at a disadvantage. Though she has a fairly strong physical attack power; the value of her other characteristics, especially physical defense, is quite low. Typical denizens of the New World and un-enchanted items pose little-to-no challenge to CZ.]

entries.name: Solution Epsilon
entries.content:
[Solution Epsilon is a slime battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Herohero.
Appearance: Solution is a blonde beauty with spiral curls and blue eyes, and clothing that emphasizes her sex appeal. The top of her maid uniform is designed to open easily, so Solution can absorb victims into her body. She rivals the most beautiful women around. As she is of the slime race, Solution can change her appearance as she wishes.
Personality: Solution thinks of humans as food and toys. She loves to swallow humans alive and enjoys the suffering and the struggling of her victims. Solution tends lure to lustful men who are after her body. She is, along with Narberal Gamma, one of the two "extremely dangerous" Pleiades. She is also good at disguising her nature, acting like a childish and rude lady. Her true nature is quite logical.. She is able to independently make decisions on her own when needed and even betray her superior, other than Ainz, if she feels that they are obstructing Nazarick's plans.
Abilities and Powers: Solution's class build is concentrated on her racial levels. Her body is said to be empty inside, and Solution can choose to protect or dissolve things she has absorbed. She can also control the speed of her digestion. She does not take damage from normal physical attacks. She is adept at dealing with the likes of physical attacks as well as having an especially strong resistance to piercing or slashing attacks. Punching her is just like punching a bag filled with water. Bludgeoning attacks can actually hurt Solution unlike slashing or piercing attacks. Solution has superior detection abilities. She specializes in detecting traps, pursuit, scouting, and the use of poison in combat. She can bypass the job restrictions of scrolls through an unidentified set of thief skills. She can inject a personally produced poison by transforming her finger into a syringe-shaped tube. She uses a skill from her assassin class to melt into the shadows and then reemerge out of it. Every bodily part of Solution's body is malleable. She is able to skillfully manipulate parts of her body into slimy whip-like arms, which can extend as far as two meters in length and silently slice them apart as if she was using knives. She can revert her human appearance back into a slime if she wishes.]

entries.name: Entoma Vasilissa Zeta
entries.content:
[Entoma Vasilissa Zeta is an arachnid battle maid and a member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. She was created by Genjiro.
Appearance: Usually, Entoma has the appearance of a young girl wearing traditional Japanese attire. She has bright red eyes that never move or blink. She has mauve hair with twin chignons. She never exposes any bare skin except for her face. Her true form is that of an arachnoid, a spider-human hybrid. What acts as her face when disguised as a human, is actually an insect in the shape of a mask of a human face. Her hair is rolled centipedes. No one is usually able to notice her disguise and do not realize she isn't human till she takes her mask off. She also disguises her voice as that of a young girl by using a leech that can steal the voices of its victims. Her own voice is harsh and grating.
Personality: Entoma likes to eat humans, her favorite part of a human being the muscular arms of men. If there are no humans to eat, she eats snacks called green biscuits instead. Her nature is not extremely evil. If she comes across humans when she is sated and they do not bother her, she will ignore them. She enjoys hunting for prey by weaving webs across Nazarick's 3rd and 6th Floors. She does not always act like a glutton. She does not like her real voice. She is the type to harbor grudges towards anyone who damages her clothing or voice, wishing to exact vengeance on them if the opportunity ever presents itself. She takes immense pride and joy at her physical appearance, role, and job given to her by her creators.
Abilities and Powers: Entoma is a spirit based magic caster who relies on insects and talismans in battle. The talismans she scatters only have magic effects, but some of her classes can use them to strengthen magic spells. She is a support maid to assist alongside her fellow Pleiades. Her stats are considerably well-rounded. She can effectively carry out both close combat and ranged attacks using summoned insects, magical attacks, and support using paper talismans. She has special abilities as an Arachnoid. She still excels in a direct fight due to her high level and the versatility of her bugs. Her weak point is that it takes some time to summon insects from talismans. Since she has many of these user level-based attacks, She has certain skills which are calculated based on her overall character level.]

entries.name: Éclair Éklair Éklare
entries.content:
[Éclair Éklair Éklare is the assistant butler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Éclair Éklair Éklare was created by Ankoro Mocchi Mochi. As a joke, his personality settings were set to have the desire to conquer Nazarick.
Appearance: Despite being a Birdman, Eclair has a very unusual appearance for one; he is a literal Rockhopper penguin, with blond hair. Eclair moves in shuffling steps, so he is always carried by another servant when he wants to get around.
Personality: Éclair has great pride in being the assistant butler of Nazarick to the point of arrogance. Carrying himself with an enormous ego of self-worth, one of his greatest desires is to sit upon the throne of Nazarick. Though Éclair understands this act is treasonous to the Forty-One Supreme Beings and likely due to him also understanding that his creator specifically made him to be this way, he still respects them highly.
Abilities and Powers: Éclair is in charge of the upkeep on the 10th Floor of Nazarick during Sebas Tian's absence. Éclair's fighting prowess is low, since his overall strength level is 1.]

entries.name: Eight-Edge Assassin
entries.content: Eight-Edge Assassin is a ninja-like insect monster. Eight-Edge Assassin is a magical being with an insect-like body shape that wears a black spider ninja costume which have big fully green glowing eyes and eight legs that are like keen blades. Eighth-Edge Assassin is a magical being that is able to render itself invisible. In addition, it can suspend itself on a ceiling like a bat. Each of its eight legs allows them to stick to the ceiling, attached with a razor. The moment it leaps towards its prey, it could launch eight simultaneous strikes. Its ability are to kill its prey with a single blow to the head. They usually protect Ainz and several are stationed in Albedo's office.

entries.name: Mirror of Remote Viewing
entries.content: Mirror of Remote Viewing is a magic item that enables the user to view other locations. It allows the user to see and observe any known or unknown location. Like a computer screen, the user can manipulate the image perception, enlarging or minimizing the view using specific hand gestures to move through what the mirror is displaying. However, a low-level anti-search magic is enough to hide from the mirror's sight and it can easily be destroyed when hit by an attack. Normally, this mirror won't offer a view indoors, but through using a magic that creates and links the sensory organ, it is possible to do so. The Wild Magic spell, [World-Isolating Barrier], can counter the mirror's abilities, unless users are equipped with World-class items.

entries.name: Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown
entries.content: Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown is a signature ring of Forty-One Supreme Beings. The Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown was once worn only by the members of Ainz Ooal Gown. This ring signifies their membership in the guild. In total, there are a hundred rings, forty-one belonging to the members of the guild and fifty-nine spares. Since the decline of Ainz Ooal Gown and the subsequent teleportation of the entire guild base into the New World, Ainz has begun to use the remaining rings to reward his servants for their efforts and maintain their loyalty. Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown is a silver wrought ring with an amethyst embedded in the center of it. The guild's symbol is also imprinted on the amethyst in black. Ring of Ainz Ooal Gown whose use was solely for traveling in and out within the Great Tomb of Nazarick. It allows the wearer to travel instantaneously anywhere within the confines of the necropolis except a few specific areas. Additionally, it is also capable of instantly changing its size to fit its user's finger size. The only flaw of the ring was that while it allowed its user to teleport freely within Nazarick, it could only teleport straight to the rooms that were either marked as important or special in Nazarick. This was not the case with rooms that had been deemed as "normal" from the start and thus one could not teleport straight to them.

entries.name: Realm of Heroes
entries.content: Realm of Heroes is a term used by the denizens of the New World that refers to a margin of considerable power for those that have surpassed the natural limitations of their race. To reach the Realm of Heroes, individuals need to cross a clear line of strength. However only a handful have ever attained such a achievement, and may be unattainable by even if they are considered the strongest warrior in the surrounding nations or adamantite class adventurers.

entries.name: Carne Village
entries.content: Carne Village is a frontier village located at the border between what was the Re-Estize Kingdom and Baharuth Empire, settled south of the Azerlisia Mountains and next to the Great Forest of Tob. While formerly part of the Kingdom, it was after the Massacre at Katze Plains that the village became part of the Sorcerer Kingdom due to the villagers' loyalty and siding with Ainz Ooal Gown. There were two routes leading northeast to Carne Village from the city of E-Rantel: One road north and another headed east along the outskirts of the forest before curving northward after a while. The distance between this village and the fortress city of E-Rantel was approximately fifty kilometers. Carne Village is located approximately 10 kilometers from the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Herbs made up a major portion of Carne Village's income as the one specialty export. While formerly being a human only village, it is now home to other Demi-human races, such as Goblins, Hobgoblins, Ogres, and other humanoids like dwarves. Carne is home to Enri Emmot, Nemu Emmot, Nfirea Bareare, Lizzie Bareare, Brita.

entries.name: Lizzie Bareare
entries.content:
[Lizzie Bareare is a pharmacist who used to operate in E-Rantel and the grandmother of Nfirea Bareare. When Nfirea was kidnapped by Zurrernorn, she made a deal with Ainz to rescue him in return for her services. Afterward, she moved to Carne Village. Lizzie is an elderly woman with a face full of wrinkles and pure white, shoulder-length hair. She and her grandson share the same blue eyes.
Lizzie Bareare is still quite sharp for her age. Highly knowledgeable about the makeup, properties, and lore of potions. She also has a demanding and fastidious personality. Her intense gaze gives other people the shivers.]

entries.name: Nfirea Bareare
entries.content:
[Nfirea Bareare is a famous pharmacist in E-Rantel. He is the grandson of Lizzie Bareare and the husband of Enri Emmot. Nfirea is a young boy with short, bowl-cut blonde hair that covers half his face. He is dressed in ragged work clothes from the potion making workshop.
Nfirea is nice, calm, and timid person. He works hard at making potions with his grandmother every day. He also has a minor inferiority complex, due to comparing himself to Ainz. When finally winning Enri's heart, this complex finally went away, revealing a more shrewd side of his personality, becoming more analytical and a sharp wit to match, the first glance of this new side to his personality is him becoming suspicious of Lord Ainz, though despite his suspicions, his loyalty to Ainz remains strong.
Nfirea was one of the best alchemists in E-Rantel. He is a 2nd Tier Magic Caster. His innate Talent allows him to equip and use any magical item regardless of restrictions. For this reason, he is considered one of the most potentially dangerous people in the New World. His skill in alchemy and the great potential of his talent makes him one of Momonga's most valuable subjects. He is level 3 Wizard, Level 4 Alchemist Genius, Level 4 Pharmacist Genius and level 1 Doctor.]

entries.name: Enri Emmot
entries.content:
[Enri Emmot is the Chieftain of Carne Village and the older sister of Nemu Emmot. She is the wife of Nfirea Bareare and General of her own Goblin Army. Growing up in Carne Village and living there all her life, Enri has always lived the life of a simple farmer's daughter. Due to her healthy lifestyle, Enri has grown to be physically fit to the point where she is considered as one of the strongest five in the village.
Appearance: Enri is a fairly beautiful young girl in her mid-teens, lightly fair skin, with blonde hair and brown eyes. She wears woolen clothes and her hair tied into a braid.
Personality: Raised by a loving family, Enri has grown up to be a kind person but has shown to have a strong character, such as her carrying out her chores without complaint. Following her election to Village Chief, she has great leadership and defending the town from monsters with the other villagers and Goblins. Her memory was wiped by Ainz, but a small subconscious part of her mind shows favor to not judge others based on looks alone, this attitude has favored her to recruit powerful demi-humans like Hobgoblins, Ogres and later, Orcs. She is a kind and just leader, which Ainz compares to his friend Touch Me. A running gag for her personality faults is the goblins, and other demi-humans telling embellished tales of her strength, charisma and leadership.
Abilities and Powers: While Enri herself is weak compared to adventurers, the Goblin Army she commands is quite strong. She has been training her command abilities by leading the goblins in different situations such as their battle with the Barghest. Her commanding skill increases and she now leads a professional army of 5,000 goblins summoned from the second horn. In fact, she has complete control over a large, powerful military force that can even defeat both the Royal Army and the Imperial Army.]

entries.name: Nemu Emmot
entries.content:
[Nemu Emmot is a villager from Carne Village and the younger sister of Enri Emmot. Nemu is described as a young little girl with reddish-brown hair and brown eyes. She wears woolen clothes and pigtails. 
Nemu has a childish and naive personality, but it seems that she may actually know more than her older sister. She used to be more bold and rebellious, but after the attack on her village and the death of her parents, she tries to be more useful and obedient to help Enri. Her boldness comes back when she gets emotional.]

entries.name: Brita
entries.content:
[Brita is a former iron ranked adventurer whose hard-earned healing potion was broken by Momon but was compensated with a new but unknown one which fortunately saved her life. Following her traumatic encounter with Shalltear, she quit being an Adventurer and moved to Carne Village as part of their Vigilance Committee and becoming it's leader. Together with the villagers, they repelled the Giant of the East's forces. Following Prince Barbro's assault on Carne, Brita is now a citizen of the Sorcerer Kingdom of Nazarick, and still active in Carne's Vigilance Committee.
Appearance: Brita is a young woman in her early twenties, she has untidy red hair trimmed short for easy movement. Although her features aren’t bad and her eyes are sharp, she doesn't wear makeup and her skin is wheat-colored after long exposure to the sun. Her arms have solid muscles and her hands are full of calluses from wielding a sword.
Personality: A brave warrior of some years experience, she did not hesitate to tell Momon off for breaking her potion bottle. Although he compensated her with a mysterious newer potion, she was cognizant enough to appraise it. She is also resolute enough to face Shalltear Bloodfallen alone, even after she slaughtered all her companions, and use her new healing potion against an Undead; which ironically saved her life.
Abilities and Powers: Her skills with a bow are impressive to the point that she was able to hit and take down a target with a few shots.]

entries.name: Blue Roses
entries.content: Blue Roses is an adamantite adventurer group and was the second to have been founded within the Re-Estize Kingdom after Red Drop. The group is all-female and is thusly comprised of just women. At some point, Blue Roses crossed paths with the Sunlight Scripture by accident, according to Gagaran, causing them to intervene when the zealous fanatics attempted to burn down an entire demi-human village. Another past event that had occurred was when Blue Roses met the legendary Vampire Lord, Evileye, and defeated her in battle. In the end, Evileye, who ended up losing to the group, later joined Blue Roses, as Rigrit had chosen the vampire to be her replacement after she left. Currently, they are on the run from the Sorcerer Kingdom after their country was decimated. The Members are Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra, Gagaran,Tina, Tia and Evileye.

entries.name: Tia
entries.content:
[Tia is an adamantite ranked adventurer and a member of Blue Roses. She is also the triplet sister of Tina and Tira. Both she and her sister were raised in the art of assassination and never trusted anyone but themselves.
