Before joining Blue Roses, Tia and her sister are believed to have originally hailed from the Baharuth Empire when they were still assassins of Ijaniya. Tia usually refers to Lakyus as Boss.
Appearance: Tia has a slender figure with fair skin, coral eyes, and blond hair that is tied in a ponytail with a blue string. Her kunoichi outfit consists of a black half-breastplate over a sleeveless mesh bodysuit, a black and blue striped headband, light orange scarf with blue flower pattern, black arm gloves with metal bracers, a light orange hakama pants, and black boots with metal plate around the shin and instep.
When not on duty, she wears a simple dark-colored yukata tied with a blue obi and a long yellow scarf that falls to her sheen.
Personality: Raised as an assassin, she is cold, professional, and the loss of human life almost never affects her emotionally. However, after joining Lakyus, she gradually developed feelings for her fellow members of Blue Roses.
Abilities: As a former assassin of Ijaniya and an adamantite-rank adventurer, Tia is skilled in espionage, stealth, tracking, and assassinations. She is also well versed in a number of poisons and other substances of the like. During her battle with Entoma, she displays incredible agility, manifests shields for defense, and hides in and create clone of herself from shadows.]

entries.name: Tina
entries.content:
[Tina is an adamantite-rank adventurer and a member of Blue Roses. She is also the triplet sister of Tia and Tira. Both she and her sister were raised in the arts of an assassin and never trusted anyone but themselves. Before becoming a member of Blue Roses, Tina, alongside her twin sister, originally hailed from the Baharuth Empire while the two are still assassins of Ijaniya at the time. Tina usually refers to Lakyus as Boss.
Appearance: Tina has a slender figure with fair skin, coral eyes, and blond hair that is tied to a ponytail with a red string. Her kunoichi outfit consists of a black half-breastplate over a sleeveless mesh bodysuit, a black and red striped headband, light orange scarf with red flower pattern, black arm gloves with metal bracers, a light orange hakama pants, and black boots with metal plate around the shin and instep.
When not on duty, she wears a simple dark-colored yukata tied with a red obi and a long yellow scarf that falls to her sheen.
Personality: Raised as an assassin, she is cold, professional, and the loss of human life almost never affects her emotionally. However, after joining Blue Rose, she gradually developed feelings for her cherished comrades. She also admits that she is a blabbermouth, stating that she can't keep a secret even at the risk of her own life.
Abilities and Powers: As a former member of Ijaniya and an adamantite-rank adventurer, she is exceptionally skilled in the art of stealth, infiltration, and assassination. With her dagger, Vampire Blade, she can disguise her kills as victims of vampirism. She can also use skills that allow the her to hide and move in the shadows.]

entries.name: Gagaran
entries.content:
[Gagaran is an adamantite ranked adventurer and a warrior from Blue Roses. Gagaran has a self-anointed nickname of "Lovely Warrior Full of Mystery", which stems from her past before joining Blue Roses, a mysterious period she does not like to talk about, even with her friends. She saved the then would-be adventurer Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra, which led her to become one of the initial members of Blue Rose.
Appearance: Usually mistaken for a man, Gagaran is an extremely muscular woman with shoulder-length blonde hair and blue eyes. She is rarely seen without heavy crimson plate armor and her mighty war pick. On her head rests a silver tiara, likely enchanted.
Personality: More than her strength, she emits a profound atmosphere of reliability, almost a "big brother" feeling that makes her extremely appreciated in the team. She has the highest respect and desire to help other people of the members of Blue Rose. Garagan holds no prejudice against non- or demi-humans. She has even professed disgust at the Slane Theocracy's practice of exterminating whole communities of other races. Gagaran has no inhibition when it comes to fighting and killing dangerous non-humans who have proven themselves a menace. A proclaimed hobby of hers is picking "fresh cherries", referring to young, virgin men. Whenever such men affirm sex with her would be enjoyable, even in jest, Gagaran would immediately overpower and drag them into a room with her.
Abilities and Powers: Gagaran is one of the strongest adventurers of the Re-Estize Kingdom. She mainly uses a war pick as her weapon of choice for not only close-range combat, but long-range as well by throwing it at her target using brute force. She is also able to perform combinations of strikes created through the application of Martial Arts. While so, she can only use magic that increases the attack power of her weapons.]

entries.name: Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra
entries.content:
[Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra is an Adamantite-Ranked Adventurer and the leader of Blue Roses. She is also the niece of fellow Adamantite-Ranked Adventurer Azuth Aindra and a former noblewoman of the now fallen Re-Estize Kingdom. When Lakyus was a young girl, she decided to become an adventurer after hearing the adventurous stories of Red Drop. Lakyus ran away from home to have an adventure of her own, while she was still inexperienced; her parents had apparently shown absolution to their daughter for this action. At some point in her lifetime, she was saved by Gagaran and the two became partners. She was also a former target for assassination by Tia and Tina, who failed during their attempt to kill her. She managed to convince them to join Blue Roses as her companions. During the last stages of Fall of the Re-Estize Kingdom, Instead of accepting her uncle's offer to escape to the Argland Council State, accepting the offer of the Black Scripture to migrate to the Slane Theocracy, or even run away herself outside the kingdom for her safety, Lakyus stubbornly chose to stay behind in the Re-Estize Kingdom and fight until her last breath to defend her country because of great deal of personal loyalty to her nation and a strong sense of patriotic justice for her countrymen. Due to this immense stubbornness, her teammates, despite not agreeing with Lakyus's desire to defend the Kingdom, knew full well it was impossible to talk her into escaping betrayed her. Her friends drugged her and was repeatedly attacked, much to her pain, sadness, and confusion. Lakyus is left in a vulnerable, weakened state to the point that she falls under the control of Evileye's spell [Charm Person]. While being mind-controlled, Evileye teleported them all and left.
Appearance: Lakyus is a young woman with long blonde hair, green eyes, and pink lips that show a healthy gleam. Her beauty falls short of Renner, but overflows with a different charm.
Personality: Lakyus is a very bright person who enjoys adventuring with her friends. She acts weird sometimes, such as wearing meaningless rings or fighting against her dark personality, making her other team members worry about her actually becoming evil. Lakyus is very kind-hearted, stubborn, and loyal.
Abilities and Powers: Lakyus has heroic-level abilities and is also one of the few users of revival magic. She can use group support magic to aid her teammates in battle. She is also able to cast a silent healing spell onto herself without speaking a word. Laykus has superhuman levels of physical and mental strength
Main Equipment: 
Cloak of Rat Speed- A ragged cloth that, when worn, increases the speed and agility of the user.
Kilineiram the Demonic Sword.
Floating Swords-The Floating Swords hovering at Lakyus's shoulders are able to rise up and be shot out at her command if she wishes.
Virgin Snow- A magic armor set that can only be worn by pure maidens.]

entries.name: Kilineiram
entries.content: Kilineiram is a cursed sword that once belonged to the Black Knight, a member of the Thirteen Heroes, and is currently possessed by the leader of Blue Roses, Lakyus. Kilineiram is about the size of a bastard sword, complete with a sheath. The blade is as black as the night. The grip is beautiful, inlaid with a black sapphire that is embedded into the pommel that is like a brightly burning flame. Kilineiram is one of the strongest blades among the Swords of Darkness. Only someone of faith can suppress this weapon's demonic power. Ainz believed that this weapon may have the ability to release waves of darkness on multiple targets.

entries.name: Evileye
entries.content:
Keno Fasris Invern, formerly known as the legendary Vampire Lord, Landfall, and currently known as Evileye, is an adamantite ranked adventurer and magic caster of Blue Roses as well as a former companion of the Thirteen Heroes. Evileye was originally a Rainbow Eye before becoming an undead. She possessed a talent that allowed her to copy any spell.
Appearance Evileye has the figure of a twelve-year-old girl. She covers herself with a reddish robe and an uncanny mask that hides her face. She is considered an enigmatic woman by others. Due to being an immortal vampire, which caused her body to stop developing at the age of twelve. Evileye wears her cloak and mask due to her vampiric nature; to keep herself safe from sunlight and to keep herself from being ostracized for it.
Personality: Evileye is sharp-tongued. However, her sharp attitude instantly changes whenever someone brings up the subject regarding Momon. Nonetheless, she trusts her allies highly and cares a lot for them. She has a soft spot for Momon, viewing him as a special individual who she is willing to offer praise for lovingly. Evileye can also be quite an emotional person on the inside, something that she tries to hide from her comrades. Due to her own arrogance, she normally tends to be ignorant of information in her surroundings. The subject of girls talk that Evileye didn't consider important made her regretful about it upon becoming infatuated with Momon afterward. Evileye once looked down upon human females who are in search of a strong partner to protect them. However, Evileye's way of thinking seems to have changed after falling in love with Momon and knowing what it is like to be protected by someone stronger than her.
Abilities and Powers: Evileye is very powerful arcane magic caster as her power has been able to damage one of the Pleiades, Entoma Vasilissa Zeta. She is more susceptible to damage from attacks that would counter her element. Evileye suffers from being hyper-specialized even amongst other elementalists, focusing mainly on Crystal generation and gravity magic. Evileye has a special ability that can cause the negative energy flowing through her body to overload and infuse every attack she makes with negative status effects. With this ability, she is capable of using her spells imbued with negative energy to drain her target's life force. Evileye wears an Enchanted Ring that conceals her status as a Vampire. She is thoroughly estimated to be around level 50. Evileye's innate talent has the ability to easily annihilate an entire city. Her Talent is the ability to store one but any spell that she has seen or been targeted with and use it for her own. She cannot willingly dismiss the stored spell. She can only release it by using it once. Evileye was considered to be the most powerful Vampire Lord throughout the history of the New World. Evileye knows over 100 magic spells.]

entries.name: Rigrit Bers Caurau
entries.content:
[Rigrit Bers Caurau was a member of the Thirteen Heroes, who fought against the Evil Deities 200 years ago. She is also a former adamantite ranked adventurer and former member of Blue Roses. Rigrit joined the Thirteen Heroes in order to fight off the swarm of Evil Deities that threatened to destroy the New World. After the group disbanded, she has spent a lot of her time in seclusion to improve her magic and has even extended her natural lifespan beyond that of natural humans.
Appearance: Rigrit is an old woman. She has grey hair tied into a ponytail. She wears a long black robe, held in place with a red jewel at the center and has a shoulder plate on her left arm side.
Personality: Rigrit has a playful and mischievous personality, despite her elderly appearance.
Abilities and Powers: Rigrit is a necromancer and extended her life with magic. She is one of the few humans who can defeat Evileye. She is capable of casting 5th tier magic spells. She has plenty of knowledge of the undead and their weaknesses. Rigrit is ranked above Remedios Custodio yet falls short below Goblin Strategist in terms of levels.]

entries.name: E-Rantel
entries.content:
E-Rantel is the capital city of the Sorcerer Kingdom, inhabited by humans and directly governed by Ainz Ooal Gown. It was formerly a fortress city under the domain of the Re-Estize Kingdom ruled by the King. For years, conflicts took place outside of the walls of the city between the Re-Estize Kingdom and the Baharuth Empire in contention of who will take control of the city. Mercenaries and adventurers were common in E-Rantel. After the events of the Massacre at Katze Plains, the city was ceded to the Sorcerer Kingdom and has been placed under its rule since then. Additionally, there were two routes leading northeast to Carne Village from E-Rantel. One headed north, and then east along the outskirts of the forest. The other went eastwards, then north. E-Rantel is divided into three zones, separated by the walls of the city. It's protected by 3 layers of city walls. The zones between each layer have their own unique characteristics. The middle zone was where people lived and the Adventurer’s Guild could be found. The outermost walls is used by the military and has all the necessary military armaments. The innermost wall houses the administrative zone. This zone has its own warehouses for food. The zone in between those two areas is the residential area for civilians. The city has several plazas within this zone, with the biggest one called the central plaza. Lots of people set up their shops there, laying out all sorts of vegetables, spices and other sorts of merchandise. 
Features(
VIP Villa: The Located in the innermost sector of the E-Rantel’s triple walls, it's the most impressive building in the city. It's Ainz Ooal Gown’s personal residence
Momon's Residence: A property introduced to Momon by Mayor Panasolei. It's a cozy, detached house that was only a little more expensive than an ordinary person's. It's a house suitable for a family without children.)

entries.name: Tsaindorcus Vaision
entries.content:
[Tsaindorcus Vaision, also known as the Platinum Dragon Lord, is a Dragon Lord and the son of the Dragon Emperor. Tsaindorcus is also a former member of the Thirteen Heroes and a councilor of the Argland Council State. Tsaindorcus regards Players as great threats to the New World with exceptions to ones who do good. Tsaindorcus is one of the few surviving True Dragon Lords who did not in anyways get involved in the war with the Eight Greed Kings. Tsaindorcus continues to live on while most of his kind was annihilated during the ensuing war which took place five hundred years ago. Tsaindorcus took residence in a floating castle with the intention of trying to guard the Eight Greed Kings magic items and prevent anyone from ever misusing them.
Appearance: Tsaindorcus is a large dragon with a very majestic form. He has white sparkling scales as if it was wearing a white faint light that flows and glitters across his body. He is graceful and elegant like a work of art.
Personality: Tsaindorcus is good-natured, benevolent, trustworthy, friendly and respectful. Although he is a kind and compassionate being, he is capable of seeing and prioritizing the bigger picture and will not hesitate to shed blood if necessary. This also extends to his allies, as he has and is willing to kill, sacrifice or deceive them if he cannot reign them in to prevent catastrophic losses or achieve a greater good. Tsaindorcus is a worrisome person with deep concerns for the safety of the New World, worrying that players may once again pollute it with their powerful Tier Magic. Tsaindorcus thinks the player's power can corrupt absolutely and permanently. In battles, Tsaindorcus is very cautious and analytical towards his foe's powers who are above his level. In spite of his beneficence, Tsaindorcus is somewhat hypocritical in his actions and personality. Tsaindorcus dislikes the abuse of power used by high-level entities. He is very apprehensive about the wrongdoings they brought to the New World in the past. For that reason, he does not seek or expect any forgiveness from players as a result of it. He also will willingly ally and trust Players if they can do good.
Abilities and Powers: Tsaindorcus might possibly be the strongest Dragon Lord at present. Tsaindorcus has his special dragon exclusive classes that shared a connection to Wild Magic. His perceptive abilities are far better than that of normal dragons. He is able to clearly see pass through Pandor's Actor's (while transformed) invisibility spell, [Perfect Unknowable]. Tsaindorcus is considered to be the most powerful dragon out of all the five permanent members within the Argland Council State. He is capable of sensing the power of a super-tier magic spell being used by a nearby player from afar. While controlling his armor in battle from afar, the equipment's abilities were said to be powered by his own health pool.]

entries.name: Azuth Aindra
entries.content:
[Azuth Aindra is a noble of the Re-Estize Kingdom and an adamantite-ranked adventurer of Red Drop. He is also the uncle of Lakyus Alvein Dale Aindra. After the Kingdom collapsed, he was given amnesty within the Argland Council State. Azuth was born to the House of Aindra, a family known to produce skilled adventurers and is a descendant of a member of the Thirteen Heroes. Bored of his life as noble, he left the family and set out to become an adventurer. During his travels he discovered a Powered Suit, a powerful item from YGGDRASIL that gave him power far superior to any normal Adventurer could achieve, and with it Azuth became a member of the Kingdom's adamantite adventurer group, Red Drop. At some point, he received a knighthood. Azuth eventually left the group and went into retirement. He also gave up his title as a noble, though he remains an honorary knight.
Appearance Azuth is a middle-aged, with handsome features and an athletic build. He has long blonde hair, which is mostly trimmed back, with streaks framing his face, his right streak is dyed red, and displays a long braid tied behind his left ear. He also sports a dark goatee, also braided.
Personality: Azuth is the type to act all honest and upstanding when meeting someone for the first time and spout corny lines. Azuth is kind of person who dislikes the proper etiquette of being called by his full name. Azuth is an eccentric womanizer and did very little to hide his hedonistic mindset. With Azuth deeming his own behavior to be "normal". Despite his quirks, he genuinely loves his family and cares for their well-being.
Abilities and Powers: Though officially an adamantite-rank adventurer, he is actually far weaker than the rest of his peers in terms of pure strength as his actual peak cap is around orichalcum-rank. His actual power directly more comes from using the YGGDRASIL item, the Powered Suit, that he owns in order to defeat stronger opponents with his entire class and skills focused on using it.]

entries.name: Captain of the Black Scripture
entries.content:
[Captain of the Black Scripture is the current leader and 1st Seat holder of the Black Scripture of the Slane Theocracy. While the Captain is a high-ranking member of the Theocracy, he lives a double life. He is in the process of attending match-making sessions to choose his bride. This was an order by the high officials requesting him to helpfully produced more potential God-kins for the future of their country.
Appearance: The Captain is a pretty young man with long black hair and sharp red eyes. He wears an ornate armor and uses a humble-looking spear. According to himself, he wears a mask that alters his face in which was younger than 20.
Personality: The Captain is very dutiful man and fulfilled his tasks accordingly. He takes his position as the leader of the Black Scripture seriously and cannot afford to slack off on the job. He is a bit optimistic of being able to finally establish enough free time after all the work he had done. Ever since his encounter with the Extra Seat and losing to her, he has since then become a very upright/honest/normal man. The moniker of the Captain of the Black Scripture is the "Black Scripture." Basically, "I alone am the Black Scripture".]

entries.name: Swords of Darkness
entries.content: Swords of Darkness were a silver-class adventurer group stationed in E-Rantel. The group's name was based on its dream of collecting the Swords of Darkness, heroic weapons that were used by the Black Knight. The members were extremely close, having braved many near-death situations together. Each member carried a black shortsword with four small jewels embedded in the hilt. The Swords of Darkness was a balanced adventurer party, consisting of a warrior (Peter Mauk), ranger (Lukrut Volve), magic caster (Ninya, younger sister of Tuareninya Veyron), and druid (Dyne Woodwonded).

entries.name: Four Armaments
entries.content: Four Armaments is a mithril adventurer team from the Re-Estize Kingdom. They were in the city E-Naeurl when it was about to be invaded by the Sorcerer Kingdom's zombie army. They battled against them. As a Mithril ranked adventurer team, with a ratio of men to women equal, their co-ordination and team composition is fairly balanced. Some members like Scama and Lilynette are very skilled at acquiring knowledge about various kinds of people, be it a magic caster or noble from the city they were stationed in. It was to the extent that. When engaging a foe who was much more powerful than them, a common tactic that Four Armaments used was immobilizing the enemy with glue and them attacking it. Known Members are ,Scama Elbero (Warrior), Lilynette Piani (Priestess) and a Thief and Magic Caster.

entries.name: Scama Elbero
entries.content:
[Scama Elbero is a mithril class adventurer and leader of Four Armaments. Scama is religious and worships the God of Fire. She defended E-Naeurl when it was invaded until a Death Knight broke through the gates. Upon encountering the undead face-to-face with its intimidating glare directed at her, she swore to herself and her companions to never again become an enemy of the Sorcerer King. While being supported by her teammates, she challenged the Death Knight head-on, barely holding her own and hardly inflicting any noticeable damage against it.
Appearance: Scama is a young female warrior with natural blonde hair but had it dyed black and then white as a way to distinguish her group more.
Personality: Scama has high sense of morality and is disgusted by the Sorcerer Kingdom. She is ambitious and determined when it comes down to promoting her adventurer group in any way she can. Even going out of her way to change up her own appearance for the sake of the team.
Abilities and Powers: Scama has the abilities of a warrior such as Martial Arts and was hailed as the strongest adventurer in the city of E-Naeurl.]

entries.name: Lilynette Piani
entries.content:
[Lilynette Piani is a mithril class adventurer and a member of Four Armaments. Lilynette is a devoted priestess of the Earth God faith.
Appearance Lilynette is a beautiful woman who irradiated a perverse aura. She has long pale-pink hair that reaches her back with two long backs on each side on her face that fall below her bosom. She has pale violet eyes. On her neck hung the holy symbol of the Earth God, which was sandwiched between her voluptuous bosom.
Personality: While being a priestess, Lilynette is well versed with the social circles of both adventurers and nobility. Lilynette is also a shotacon as she has a preference for young boys to the ages of twelve. Those around the ages of fifteen and above are considered too old for her. The priestess is quite cunning and manipulative as she managed to convince Count Naeura to hand over their Holy Sword and acquire the youngest son to be her personal concubine to fulfill her desires. She is shameless of her behavior, never hiding her intentions out in public and even drooling about the object of her desire.
Abilities and Powers: Lilynette has connections to the Temple of the Four Great Gods. As a priestess serving the Earth God, she uses of her connections with the Temple of the Four Great Gods to gather intel. Lilynette performs such feat without the latter learning of this until she decided to outright explain some of it in great detail much to his displeasure.]

entries.name: Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix
entries.content:
[Jircniv Rune Farlord El-Nix is the current Emperor of the Baharuth Empire, also known as the "Bloody Emperor" for his violent purge of the nobility. Upon learning of Ainz, he intended to turn him into his pawn, until he learned of his true nature. Afterwards, while initially opposing the Sorcerer King, he ultimately submitted and became his vassal. Jircniv's mother was from the Five Great Families of the Empire. He had been born and raised as a candidate to be the next Emperor, and everyone around him of his age considered him the Crown Prince. Tragedy struck when his mother poisoned his father to secure his place on the throne. Jircniv had to eliminated his family members for political reasons; since then, part of his heart has remained broken. He continued to live on with his life. At the age of twelve and his ascension to the throne, he executed the order to purge many of the nobles who dared try to oppose him. Due to the amount of bloodshed and violence during the purge, he became known as the Bloody Emperor. Under his reign, he strengthened and enriched the Empire using his political power, overwhelming charisma, and military strength. He is considered the greatest emperor in the nation's history by its people. Jircniv has a harem of women to entertain himself with. Jircniv has absolute political and military power within the Baharuth Empire.
Appearance: Jircniv is a handsome young man with blonde hair that "reflects with magical illumination just like the shine of the stars", and "clear purple eyes that look like amethysts".
Personality: Jircniv is extremely charismatic and well-educated, both in academics and the culture of courtly life. He was groomed for his position as emperor and has cultivated a well-crafted persona of a great ruler. Outwardly, he is calm and confident, believing people will only follow strong leaders. Even in the direst of circumstances, he maintains a cool head and will act rationally for the good of his Empire. He is very careful about his reputation, controlling his body language perfectly. He always puts off the front of a friendly gentleman and will always be polite in spite of his feelings. Jircniv is very ambitious. Although Jircniv is ruthless about his own authority, he doesn't seem concerned with power in and of itself. Jircniv wants to create a great empire that will stand the test of time. He focuses only on what's beneficial to his empire's development and growth and tries to rid away with anything that will get in the way of that objective. Jircniv is a very pragmatic ruler and will even elevate commoners to high ranking positions if they are capable of doing an excellent job. Jircniv will not attempt to do anything immoral if there is no reason to do so.
Abilities and Powers: Jircniv has military experience. Jircniv’s senses are very sharp, and he had once discovered that a seemingly loyal noble had actually been scheming and plotting. Jircniv has something of a sixth sense.
Main Equipment: Imperial Scepter(The Blood Emperor's staff of office. He carries this during state visits to foreign dignitaries or during imperial courts); Medallion of Mental Protection; Ring of Unicorn(Magic ring that can detect poisons and also enhances resistance against them); A Magic ring that gets rid of stomach pains, a gift from Ainz.]

entries.name: Leinas Rockbruise
entries.content:
[Leinas Rockbruise is the only female member of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire. Leinas was born to a noble family of the Baharuth Empire, where she earned a measure of fame and renown by defeating monsters and beasts around her family's domain. However, she was cursed after she slew a monster, which disfigured the right side of her face. Her fiancé abandoned her and her family disowned her. Afterwards, her only goal in life became to get revenge on those who wronged her and to find a way to cure her so-called "incurable" curse. Leinas's abilities and reputation eventually caught Emperor Jircniv's attention, who allowed her to have her revenge in exchange for joining his personal guard. She use her new position to request the Court Wizard, Fluder Paradyne to rid of her curse, but even his efforts fail to bring results.
Appearance: Leinas is a beautiful woman with fair skin, green eyes and long blond hair with bangs covering the right side of her face and a beauty mark beneath her lower lip on the left side. She has a brown string tied around her head, and tied her hair back in a loose ponytail tied a few inches above the end. The right side of her face is in a disgusting state due to a curse which causes it to secrete pus.
Personality: Leinas is formal but aloof, direct and blunt. She is self-serving because of her curse and the circumstances after, she made it clear to Jircniv she only serve him because it is most profitable for her to do so, and will immediately abandon her position if someone else can provide her with what she wants. Due to her disfigured face, she somewhat ashamed of it and is envious to the beauty of other women.
Abilities and Powers: Leinas is a very skilled and powerful warrior, only slightly weaker than Gazef Stronoff. She has the highest offensive ability when compared to the Imperial Knights. She’s is quite agile, even while wearing plate armor and on a horse. Leinas has some proficiency with a spear.]

entries.name: Baziwood Peshmel
entries.content:
[Baziwood Peshmel is the acting leader of the Four Imperial Knights of the Baharuth Empire. A commoner born in a back alley, Baziwood understood that he would die in that alley if he did not obtain the power to survive. For that very reason, he strive to become a knight, hunting down monsters, almost died on several occasions. He eventually distinguished himself to earn Jircniv's attention and inducted into the Four Imperial Knights after left “vacated” by Gazef Stronoff. Through hard work he also became a noble with the rank of count. He eventually took several prostitutes as wives and several more as lovers, five of which live under the same roof.
Appearance: Baziwood is a very tall, middle-aged man with a largely muscular build, fair skin and blue eyes. He has long blonde hair tied to a ponytail, with matching short chin beard and lack of eyebrows.
Personality: Baziwood is excessively informal. He was taught and corrected, but the status of his common birth was occasionally evident in his speech. Even to his liege, he remains blunt and honest, forgoing formalities. He’s a womanizer with a penchant for prostitutes, for he marries an untold number of them and still maintain very good relationships with.
Abilities and Powers: Baziwood is regarded as the strongest of the Four Imperial Knights and one of the strongest warriors of the Empire. He has great proficiency with a broadsword.]

entries.name: Fluder Paradyne
entries.content:
[Fluder Paradyne is the Imperial Court Wizard of the Baharuth Empire. He is the headmaster of the Imperial Magic Academy and he is also in charge of the Ministry of Magic in Arwintar. Fluder is considered to be the Strongest Wizard of the Empire and is said to be comparable to the Thirteen Heroes. Fluder was born in Belmous Village. His first contact and interest in learning magic were because of a magic caster he came into contact with in his village. Fluder has a great jealousy and envy toward the Thirteen Heroes along with the desire to surpass Rigrit. At one point in his life, Fluder attempted to use a ritual spell to obtain immortality, but due to the imperfect casting, he only managed to slow the aging process to over two hundred years. For six generations, Fluder has served the Baharuth Empire faithfully as a court wizard.
Appearance: Fluder is an elderly man of short stature, possessing a magnificent white beard, with a head full of snow-white hair. He has wrinkles, and the light of wisdom in his eyes. While Fluder is mostly seen wearing a soft loose white robe, he also has on his neck a necklace made with numerous crystal orbs. Decorated with his fingers are numerous magical rings.
Personality: Fluder is polite individual who shows very little concern in political and social circles. Magic is both Fluder's passion and obsession. He spends most of his time focusing on his studies regarding the development field of magic, in the hopes of enhancing his power. He has a saintly demeanor, and is honored and respected by many people. Fluder longs to have a magic caster stronger than himself and be a student again. He is quite jealous of the youths he taught for their higher chance of seeing the abyss of magic he sought. Despite his disinterest in subjects other than magic, he is self-conscious enough to know to present himself accordingly in any situation. When presented with an opportunity to advance his magical knowledge, he loses all sense of self-control and dignity. Fluder is actually a selfish individual that is not above sacrificing everyone and everything for his goal of obtaining great magical knowledge. His dearest desire is to see the abyss of magic and become stronger.
Abilities and Powers: Fluder is 6th tier of arcane magic caster. Fluder is famous for being able to use three different systems of magic (Arcane, Divine & Spiritual). He has an innate talent that allows him to see the magic aura of a magic caster, allowing him to determine their power and to what tier of magic they are capable of using.]

entries.name: Imperial Magic Academy
entries.content: The Imperial Magic Academy is a state-funded educational institution in the Baharuth Empire for higher learning for magic based in Arwintar that trains magic casters. The Imperial Magic Academy only admitted citizens of the Empire. The Empire's magical academy deemed those who were excellent as those worth attending tuition-free. The Imperial Academy awarded scholarships to high achieving students. And to qualify, one had to pass a difficult entrance examination. While the organization is associated with magic, most of its students cannot perform. In this case, it serves as an intermediary between a high school and a university. Since magic was an intricate part of human society, they incorporate their learning material into their curriculum. There was a rumor that if a student could successfully tamper with a sealed magical item and replicate its contents before he or she was expelled for the penalty, that student would be recruited by the Ministry of Magic right away be given a high position. The academy had aimed to create an environment where students of all years could mix, and thus there was only one cafeteria. The administrators provided the basic lunch for free. The only time one paid was for the more extravagant orders. The Imperial Magic Academy has a student council composed of students; the council doesn't retain a lot of power overall, but it still has some authority. Among the student body, there are noble students, very intelligent students, and very popular students; noble students want to be on the student council as it gives them status.

entries.name: Arwintar
entries.content: Arwintar is the imperial capital city of the Baharuth Empire. Arwintar is situated slightly west from the center of the Empire. Although the population might be less than that of the capital of Re-Estize, Arwintar is much grander. Due to many years of reform by the Emperor himself, the Empire is currently experiencing the largest influx of development ever recorded in history. New things are constantly being introduced and brought out to society, giving rise to the opportunity for merchants to explore many new markets. A constant influx of goods and talents is seen in the Empire’s capital. No other nation has ever attempted such a grand endeavor in constructing that kind of city due to the sheer scale and cost in funding this project. An impressive feat of civil engineering; Arwintar’s existence is a testament of the might and wealth of the Empire. The architecture and layout of the city is quite advanced, the roads of the city are segregated into separate lanes to allow for ease of traffic. Raised sidewalks and fences bordering the streets have been erected to ensure the safety of pedestrians. Public lighting is maintained and powered by magic during the night. The streets are regularly patrolled by platoons of knights. Imperial Palace lies at the center of the city. The area around the Imperial Palace is surrounded by numerous universities, magic academies, and governmental institutions. Grand Arena is one of the iconic features of the Imperial Capital. It serves as a gathering for grand events and social outings, such as the Grand Combat Tournament and gladiatorial fights.
